scope: Same Workboard project and frozen stack. Public acceptance sketches only; tests, fixtures and phase counts not prepared. No dispatch authorization is exercised by this file.

requirements.title: Bound individual task notes
requirements.public_acceptance: Save notes must accept at most 10,000 Unicode code points after the established LF normalization. An oversized individual save announces Task notes must be at most 10000 characters, retains the rejected textarea and changes no stored field. Empty notes clear the value. Preserve exact literal whitespace, Unicode, filtering, ownership, completion, priority, due date and all reserved positions. Existing imports and bulk notes keep their established validation. Verify 10,000/10,001 emoji, reload, later moves and restart.

requirements.title: Bound project names
requirements.public_acceptance: New project creation and project rename accept trimmed nonempty names of at most 200 Unicode code points. Oversized direct input announces Project name must be at most 200 characters, remains available to edit and causes no mutation. Both project and workspace imports reject oversized names atomically using their existing invalid-JSON messages, including an oversized final owner. Existing records, including any previously valid longer name, remain unchanged. Preserve duplicate identities, creation positions, archived state, defaults, task metadata and reserved positions. Search and project-name ordering use successful current renames.

requirements.title: Bound task titles
requirements.public_acceptance: Task creation and rename accept trimmed nonempty titles of at most 500 Unicode code points. Oversized direct input announces Task title must be at most 500 characters, retains the rejected input and causes no mutation. Both import formats reject oversized titles atomically using their existing invalid-JSON messages, including an oversized last task. Existing longer records remain unchanged. Preserve literal internal whitespace, Unicode, completion, priority, due date, notes, deletion and every owner position. Successful renames re-evaluate existing search and ordering.

requirements.title: Directory word search modes
requirements.public_acceptance: Add Directory search mode with Phrase, All words and Any words, default Phrase. Phrase retains the existing normalized literal title search. All words requires every query token and Any words requires at least one token in the normalized task title. Split only on ASCII spaces/tabs after existing trimming and normalization; fold ASCII case only. Empty query matches all in every mode. Matching uses titles only and intersects every existing scope, completion, priority and date filter. Preserve ordering, matching owner creation order, summaries, disabled protections, matching export and all bulk actions. Selecting a mode re-evaluates the current query without mutating records.

requirements.title: Directory due-date presence
requirements.public_acceptance: Add Directory due status with All, Dated and Undated, default All. Dated matches nonempty due dates; Undated matches empty due dates. Intersect this with the existing inclusive range and all other matching conditions. An Undated selection with a nonempty date boundary has no matches. Current matching exports, counts, represented owners and every bulk action honor the same selection. Saving or clearing a visible date can change membership without losing other current controls or protected fields.

requirements.title: Directory notes presence
requirements.public_acceptance: Add Directory notes status with All, Empty and Present, default All. Empty means the stored normalized notes are exactly empty; whitespace-only notes are Present. Intersect with all other directory conditions. Keep title search independent of note contents. Counts, represented owners, matching export and all bulk actions use these matches. A successful notes clear or assignment re-evaluates membership and keeps other controls, metadata, identities and positions.

requirements.title: Directory owner-default filter
requirements.public_acceptance: Add Project default priority with All, Low, Normal and High, default All. This matches the owning project default, independently of the task priority. Intersect with all other directory conditions in Active and Archived scopes, including Deleted. Current defaults after rename, restoration and imports are used. Matching counts, owner summaries, exports and every bulk action honor the owner-default condition. Viewing or selecting it never changes an owner default or an existing task priority.

requirements.title: Directory prefix search
requirements.public_acceptance: Append Starts with to Directory search mode. It matches the beginning of the normalized task title against the whole normalized query, with the same ASCII-only case folding and space/tab normalization as Phrase. An empty query matches all. It is distinct from substring and word matching. Keep all other filters, ordering, summaries, owners, bulk protections and matching export coherent, and preserve stored literal fields.

requirements.title: Archive or restore represented projects
requirements.public_acceptance: Add Archive visible projects and Restore visible projects in Task directory. Archive operates only in Active scope and restore only in Archived scope, on each represented matching owner exactly once, including when matching tasks are Deleted. The other action and both empty-result actions are disabled. Preserve current directory controls, original owner creation order, defaults, every task including excluded/deleted tasks, and all reserved positions. Do not archive or restore owners without matching tasks. Duplicate names remain distinct. Successful mutation re-evaluates membership; the existing task bulk protections remain unchanged. Verify reload, later moves and actual restart.

requirements.title: Assign represented-owner defaults
requirements.public_acceptance: Add Visible projects default priority with Low, Normal and High, default Normal, and Set visible project default. In Active scope assign that default once to every currently represented matching owner, including Deleted matches; disable the action in Archived scope or with no matches. Preserve all existing task priorities and other fields, owner identities/order and reserved positions. Current owner-default filtering can remove changed owners from the result, but every owner from the initial match receives the assignment. New tasks subsequently inherit the new default. Matching workspace/project exports and restart retain it; duplicate owner names remain independent.
